name: Anti-Hero
syncedLyrics:
[00:05.39] I have this thing where I get older but just never wiser
[00:10.37] Midnights become my afternoons
[00:15.19] When my depression works the graveyard shift
[00:18.34] All of the people I've ghosted stand there in the room
[00:24.60] I should not be left to my own devices
[00:28.01] They come with prices and vices
[00:30.69] I end up in crises
[00:32.41] Tale as old as time
